svg.title: Antivirals decision chart: the virus picks the drug. Herpesviruses: acyclovir or valacyclovir for HSV and VZV, ganciclovir or valganciclovir for CMV, foscarnet for resistant virus. Influenza: oral oseltamivir, inhaled zanamivir or single-dose baloxavir, each with when to choose it, dose and route, and what to watch

svg.text: herpesviruses: block viral DNA polymerase · influenza: mostly block neuraminidase, so new virus cannot leave the cell
